name: Onmyou Kishi Towako ~Hebigami no Inma Choukyou~
original_name: 陰陽騎士トワコ～蛇神の淫魔調教～
source:
Since ancient times, "diviners" wielded a great summoning magick.
In the age of science they led private lives, but there were some who abused their powers.

Normal men and women were helpless against such criminals.
Thus, the government employed trusted diviners, called "knights", to defend us from those gone rogue. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE120153.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
自古以來，「陰陽師」便掌握著強大的召喚術。
在科學昌明的時代，他們過著隱秘的生活，但其中，也有人濫用自己的力量。

普通民眾面對這些罪犯毫無還手之力。
因此，政府僱用了值得信賴的陰陽師，將他們稱作「騎士」，保護我們，抵禦那些走上邪路的人。

［摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE120153.html]DLsite英文版[/url]］
